background_notes.fact: Under H006 and H005, x and y restrict to Z-linear endomorphisms of M, and h restricts as h^M=x^M y^M-y^M x^M.

grounds.reason: M is an additive subgroup stable under every divided power, in particular X_1 and Y_1.

background_notes.justification: For m in M, both y(m) and x(m) lie in M, hence x(y(m))-y(x(m)) lies in M and equals h(m). Restrictions of the additive complex-linear maps are Z-linear, and restriction commutes with this composition and subtraction. This justifies the lattice-action remark without any extra lattice assumption.

background_notes.fact: For the L_K action of D008, a K-linear subspace W of U is invariant under L_K if and only if it is invariant under the induced x,y,h operators.

grounds.reason: L_K is the scalar extension of Zx+Zy+Zh, with its action extended K-linearly.
The module and operators are precisely the prescribed original induced action, also in characteristic 2.
W is a K-linear subspace of U.

background_notes.justification: Every element of (Zx+Zy+Zh) tensor_Z K is a finite sum of pure tensors. Expanding the integral factor as an integer linear combination of x,y,h shows its action is a K-linear combination of the three induced operators. If they preserve W, closure of W under scalar multiplication and addition proves invariance under every such action. Conversely their tensors with 1 are elements of L_K, so L_K-invariance implies all three generator conditions. No linear independence or division by 2 is required.
